meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行多视角审查用户故事，给出对抗性改进意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速获得多角度的用户故事评审反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Get multi-perspective adversarial review of user stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick multi-perspective feedback on your user stories.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按“story-review”流程审查小说:找出结构、角色、文字、设定等方面的问题,按 S1-S4 分级给出可执行修改建议;报告开头会列出实际执行模式与所用评分标准。
howto.when: 当你说“/story-review”“/审查”“审查一下”等指令,或要求“帮我审一下”时触发;未指定模式时默认 full。

say.text: 用 full 模式审查我最近改的第三章
say.note: 会并行调用四个审查视角(若可用)。

say.text: 按番茄平台的标准审这段开头
帮我审一下设定文件,找前后矛盾
say.note: 侧重一致性与事实冲突。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude orchestrates story-review: it examines the novel for structural, character, prose, and setting issues, rates findings S1-S4, and gives actionable fixes. The report header lists the actual execution mode and rubric used.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/story-review", "/审查", "审查一下", or ask to "帮我审一下"; defaults to full mode if unspecified.

say_en.text: Review the chapter I most recently edited in full mode.
say_en.note: Spawns all four review lenses when available.

say_en.text: Review this opening using the Fanqie rubric.
Check the setting files for contradictions.
say_en.note: Focuses on consistency and factual conflicts.
